en.summary: Croup often follows colds with a barking cough and harsh breathing-in sound. Call urgent advice if suspected. Emergency if struggling to breathe, colour change, very sleepy/floppy, or drooling with swallow difficulty. Do not use steam rooms (NHS).
emergencyIf: Struggling to breathe (grunting, tummy sucking under ribs)
Sleepier than normal or difficult to wake
Very upset with breathing difficulty that cannot be calmed
Unwell and drooling more / hard to swallow
seeDoctorIf: Getting worse after seeing a clinician
selfCare: Sit upright; keep calm; fluids; check overnight
doNot: Do not put child in a steamy room or force steam inhalation (NHS)

fr.summary: Le croup donne souvent une toux aboyante et un stridor. Avis urgent si suspecté. Urgence si détresse respiratoire, cyanose, enfant mou/somnolent. Pas de pièces à vapeur (NHS).

he.summary: קרופ לרוב עם שיעול נביחה וסטרידור. ייעוץ דחוף בחשד. חירום במצוקה נשימתית, כיחלון או ילד רפוי/ישנוני. לא חדרי אדים (NHS).

ru.summary: Круп часто даёт лающий кашель и стридор. При подозрении — срочный совет. Неотложка при дыхательной недостаточности, синюшности или вялости. Не использовать паровые комнаты (NHS).

sources.name: NHS — Colds, coughs and ear infections in children
